sentences.text: In a queue one must stand patiently.
On the bus one may stand.
A soldier learns to stand straight.
At the corner one must turn slowly.
The dancer likes to turn quickly.
The body is easy to turn in water.
On ice it is easy to fall.
Leaves begin to fall in autumn.
Be careful so you do not fall from the stairs.
It is pleasant to give a friend a gift.
The teacher begins to give a task.
Please give me the book.
The bag is easy to hold by hand.
The child learns to hold a spoon.
One must hold the rope firmly.
A lemon is easy to squeeze by hand.
One must squeeze the button firmly.
Do not start to squeeze the hand too hard.
It is pleasant to rub cold hands.
One must rub the dirty glass.
The cat likes to rub against your legs.
One must wash the dishes in the evening.
The child learns to wash hands.

sentences.target: մեքենան հաճելի է լվալ շաբաթ օրը։
sentences.text: It is pleasant to wash the car on Saturday.

One must pull the box carefully.

Children begin to push the swing.
It is pleasant to throw a ball.
One must throw trash into the bin.

sentences.target: ձուկ որսալու համար կարելի է նետել ցանց։
sentences.text: To catch fish one may throw a net.
One must tie the rope tightly.
The child learns to tie shoes.
It is pleasant to tie a gift with a ribbon.
A button is easy to sew.
Mother likes to sew in the evening.
The tailor begins to sew a coat.
It is pleasant to count the stars.

sentences.target: երեխան սովորում է հաշվել մինչև տասը։
sentences.text: The child learns to count to ten.
One must count the money carefully.
One must say the truth.
It is pleasant to say thank you.
The teacher begins to say the rules.
The choir likes to sing together.
It is pleasant to sing in the bathroom.
The bird begins to sing in the morning.
It is pleasant to play in the yard.
Children like to play with a ball.
In the evening we begin to play chess.

sentences.target: տերևը կարող է ջրի վրա լողալ։
sentences.text: A leaf can float on water.

sentences.target: նավակը սկսում է ջրի վրա լողալ։
sentences.text: The boat begins to float on water.

sentences.target: փայտը կարող է ջրի վրա լողալ։
sentences.text: Wood can float on water.
The river likes to flow fast.

Water begins to flow from the tap.

A foot may swell from an injury.
An eye begins to swell from a blow.

sentences.target: հացը սիրում է ուռել թխելուց առաջ։
sentences.text: Bread likes to swell before baking.
The sun lights up the room.
In summer the sun is warm.
The sun sets in the evening.
The moon shines at night.
A full moon is round.
The moon appears through the clouds.
A star shines in the dark sky.
The child counts a star.
A star falls on a summer night.
Water flows in the river.

sentences.target: ես խմում եմ ջուր ամեն օր։

Heavy rain beats on the roof.

A stone is heavy and cold.

Sand gets into the shoe.

The wind raises dust.
I wipe dust from the shelf.
